name: Ero Mangaka To Dokidoki Dousei Seikatsu

When the manga artist struggles with inspiration, as her assistant, you’ll use "special methods" to ignite her creative passion! From daily care to intimate nighttime moments, your bond deepens, unlocking embarrassing scenes and sweet CGs. Experience a thrilling and heart-pounding cohabitation!
